notes.title: Jezzball Deluxe Edition is finally out! Thank you for playing it.
notes.content:
Thirty years ago, I dreamed of remaking Jezzball, the Windows 3.1 classic that hooked me with its simple brilliance. Today, that dream drops on Steam as [b]Jezzball Deluxe Edition[/b]—rebuilt from scratch with real physics for a bouncier, fresher challenge! Every purchase fuels my next project and supports my family. Grab it now and relive the nostalgia—or discover it anew!

[previewyoutube=9Bpx3OXsOo4;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you had fun!

Please share the game with your friends, and take care.

Martin
